name: Scale Stack
author: Tom Burns
description: Five voices spaced an equal number of scale degrees apart, sweeping from cluster to wide chord without ever leaving the scale. From Braids Renaissance.

controls.label: Span
controls.description: Sets the spacing between voices, from one scale degree up to sixteen.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Detunes the voices against each other and folds them near sine.

controls.label: Waveform
controls.description: Morphs every voice from sine through triangle and saw to square.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale the stack is quantised to, which is what the spacing counts in.

outputs.aux: The root voice alone, as a pitch reference.
